description: Adopt four practices from the Epic Loop skill (malston/marks-marketplace) that the g2g build loop lacks: an enforced read-only verifier, mutation proof for new tests, a human-decision exit with decisions and FLAG lines surfaced in the PR, and an opt-in per-task regression check. Spec A of two; the GitHub issue export and spec lint are specs/issue-export-and-spec-lint.json, built after this merges. Beads is deliberately not adopted; a cross-vendor verifier is deliberately out of scope (see constraints).

context.currentState: As of plugin 0.7.6: the g2g-verifier is read-only by prompt only (plugin/agents/g2g-verifier.md has no tools allowlist and nothing checks the checkout after it runs). Builders are told to go test-first but never prove a new test can fail. A builder can report only DONE or FAILED (build.md Phase 3 step 7 treats any other result as no report at all), so a task that needs a human choice burns attempts until it blocks, and anything a passing builder left unchecked is buried in spec notes; PR bodies are composed inline with no --body-file. Verification commands run only in the no-report fallback and at completion, so a regression from task 2 surfaces at the finish line.
context.targetState: The verifier is tool-narrowed and its dispatch is bracketed by a deterministic HEAD/tree snapshot comparison. Every test a builder adds carries mutation evidence, and gaps are surfaced in the PR. Builders can return NEEDS_DECISION with a recommendation, which blocks the task without consuming attempts; decisions and FLAG lines appear in a 'Needs your attention' PR section passed via --body-file, and /g2g:status lists needs-human tasks. An opt-in verifyEachTask flag runs the verification commands after every reported DONE.
constraints: Every behavior change reaches BOTH engines. build-wf.md executes build.md's Phases 1, 2, 4 and 5 by reference, so changes to those phases reach it automatically and must NOT be copied into build-wf.md. Phase 3 (task loop) changes also land in plugin/workflows/g2g-build.js, and any new wrapper arg in build-wf.md Phases 1 and 3.

The BUILDER REPORT / VERIFIER REPORT markers and existing fields keep their names; new fields are additive, and build.md, g2g-build.js and tests/commands.bats change in the same commit as any report-contract change.
g2g-evidence.sh output and exit codes stay byte-identical: tests/plugin_evidence.bats and tests/plugin_stop.bats pass without modification.
No new task status values: a decision-blocked task uses status 'blocked' with notes starting 'needs-human:'.
New config flags (verifyEachTask) default to false in every plugin/templates/*.json, pinned by tests/templates.bats; with the flags absent or false, behavior is unchanged from 0.7.6.

Untrusted text never enters shell command source (L-004, docs/learnings/commands/untrusted-text-in-shell-templates.md). That covers builder-written text (notes, decision text, FLAG lines): it reaches gh only via --body-file or a file read by a helper script, never pasted into a command.
Version bump happens exactly once, in T-001, to 0.8.0 with a CHANGELOG.md 0.8.0 section. Later tasks append bullets to that section and never bump again.

Known debt, tracked and not fixed here: the new report fields extend F-046 (report schema defined in several files) and the new config defaults extend F-029 (defaults duplicated across files). Do not refactor either in this spec.

Out of scope: a verifier from another vendor (e.g. Codex). g2g-stop.sh completes only on a VERIFIER REPORT from a dispatched g2g:g2g-verifier subagent, and the Agent tool cannot route to a non-Claude model, so such a verifier could only advise, never gate. If pursued, it is a separate opt-in, advisory-only experiment spec measured against the existing manual pre-merge Codex adversarial review. No task here adds one.
make smoke and make smoke-wf are the human merge gate for this PR (commands, agents and the workflow change); they are not verification commands here.

Two commits on the build branch precede the build and are expected, not builder work: .claude/g2g.json raising defaultBudgets.buildHours from 2 to 3 (sized from this repo's build history), and specs/issue-export-and-spec-lint.json (spec B, pending). Neither is a commit-hygiene violation.

tasks.title: Enforce a read-only verifier
tasks.description: Owns the version bump for the whole spec: set plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json version to 0.8.0 and add a '## 0.8.0' section to CHANGELOG.md in this task's commit. Every other task appends bullets to that section and never bumps. Then: (1) Add a 'tools:' line to plugin/agents/g2g-verifier.md's frontmatter allowing exactly Read, Grep, Glob, Bash (no Edit, Write or NotebookEdit). Bash can still write files, so this narrows the verifier without sealing it; step (2) is the enforcement, and the CHANGELOG bullet must say so. (2) In plugin/commands/build.md Phase 4 step 1, immediately before the verifier dispatch, record a PRE-VERIFY SNAPSHOT: 'git rev-parse HEAD' plus 'git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all' with the goal/lock/mutex trio filtered out. In Phase 4 step 2, after the POST-WAIT REFRESH exits 0 and before reading the verdict, take the same snapshot and compare. Any difference means the verifier changed the checkout: ignore its verdict (PASS included), write nothing to the spec, revert nothing, and go to Phase 5 with the drift named (the changed paths, or the new commit's sha if HEAD moved) so the partial PR lists it. (3) build-wf.md already executes build.md's Phase 4 by reference, so it inherits the check: do NOT copy it into build-wf.md. (4) Document the enforcement in plugin/README.md's Guardrails section and docs/G2G_PLUGIN_REF.md section 9 (Safety model).

tasks.title: Require mutation proof for new tests
tasks.description: Add rule 9 to plugin/agents/g2g-builder.md: for every test the builder adds or strengthens, before its single commit it (a) breaks the behavior the test guards (reverts the implementation hunk or inverts the guard), (b) runs that test and shows it FAIL, (c) restores the code, and (d) runs it again and shows it PASS. A test that still passes against broken code must be fixed before committing. Add one field to the BUILDER REPORT between 'verified:' and 'notes:': 'mutation: <one line per new or strengthened test: test name, what was broken, observed FAIL then PASS>' or 'mutation: n/a (no tests added)'. In build.md Phase 3, step 7 reads the field and step 8 copies it into the task's notes on DONE; when it is missing, step 8 writes 'mutation: not reported' into the notes instead, and a missing field is never a FAIL by itself. The no-report fallback (step 7 f) writes 'mutation: not reported (BUILDER REPORT never arrived)'. In plugin/workflows/g2g-build.js add an optional 'mutation' string to builderSchema (required fields and the result enum unchanged by this task) and have the complete-writer agent add the mutation line to the notes it writes. The verifier is deliberately NOT a hard gate on missing evidence: a missing-evidence FAIL would send a Phase 4 fix builder to the finish line with no way to record evidence against the original task, looping until REVERIFY_CAP. Instead, add an additive 'flags:' field after 'commands:' in the VERIFIER REPORT in plugin/agents/g2g-verifier.md, and a procedure step: list one line per test added in the branch diff whose task notes carry no mutation evidence, or 'none'. A test the verifier can see is vacuous by reading it stays a FAIL finding under procedure step 3, as today. build.md Phase 4 step 2 reads 'flags:', and the PR bodies in Phase 4 step 7 and Phase 5 step 2 include those lines (T-003 later moves them into a dedicated section). Append a bullet to the CHANGELOG 0.8.0 section; no version bump (T-001 owns it).

build.md step 7 names the mutation field, step 8 copies it into task notes on DONE, writes 'mutation: not reported' when it is missing, and never scores FAILED on its absence alone
plugin/workflows/g2g-build.js builderSchema has an optional 'mutation' string, its required list and result enum are unchanged, and the complete-writer prompt copies the mutation line into notes

tasks.title: Add a NEEDS_DECISION exit and surface decisions and FLAG lines in the PR
tasks.description: Builders can report only DONE or FAILED, so a task that needs a human judgment (keep vs delete, pick an API shape) burns two attempts and blocks with no recommendation, and work that passed with something left unchecked is invisible in the PR. (1) NEEDS_DECISION. In plugin/agents/g2g-builder.md allow 'result: DONE | FAILED | NEEDS_DECISION' and add a 'decision:' field after 'mutation:' holding the question, the options, and the builder's recommendation with its reason. Rule: NEEDS_DECISION requires 'commit: none' and an untouched tree, and is only for a task that cannot be completed without a choice the spec does not make. In build.md Phase 3 step 7, a report whose result is NEEDS_DECISION is usable (today only DONE and FAILED are; anything else falls into the no-report fallback). Step 8's SPEC RESTORE entry gate still runs first, unchanged. Then, on NEEDS_DECISION, the orchestrator checks for itself (never trusting the builder's claim) that HEAD equals the DISPATCH BASELINE and the tree is CLEAN by step 7's definition: if both hold, set status 'blocked', leave attempts unchanged, and write notes starting 'needs-human: ' followed by the decision text; otherwise score the attempt FAILED (attempts + 1) with notes saying a NEEDS_DECISION arrived with changes and naming them. In plugin/workflows/g2g-build.js add NEEDS_DECISION to the result enum and 'decision' as an optional string; add an optional 'head' string to writerSchema and have the start writer report HEAD after its commit; on NEEDS_DECISION a writer agent confirms HEAD still equals that value and 'git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all' shows nothing but the spec and the goal/lock/mutex trio, then writes blocked with attempts unchanged; if the check fails the script scores FAILED exactly like its FAILED branch. plugin/commands/status.md lists, per spec, the tasks whose notes start 'needs-human:' and stays read-only. plugin/skills/writing-g2g-specs/SKILL.md documents the convention and the way out: a human answers by amending the task (description or criteria), clearing its notes, setting status back to 'pending', and re-running '/g2g:build <spec> --continue-branch'; a needs-human task also stalls every task that depends on it. (2) FLAG lines. Add a builder rule: anything the builder could not check that lies outside the acceptance criteria (an environment it could not reach, a follow-up it noticed, a mutation it could not perform) goes into notes as its own line starting 'FLAG: '. A FLAG never substitutes for a criterion: an acceptance criterion that could not be verified makes the result FAILED. (3) PR body. Every 'gh pr create' in build.md (Phase 4 steps 5 and 7, Phase 5 step 2) writes the body with the Write tool to a file in a 'mktemp -d' directory and passes it with '--body-file <file>'; builder notes, decision text and FLAG lines are untrusted and never enter command source. The body gains a 'Needs your attention' section, omitted when empty, holding 'Decisions for you' (each needs-human task: id, title, decision text) and 'Flags' (every notes line starting 'FLAG:' across all tasks, prefixed with its task id, plus the verifier's 'flags:' lines from T-002). build-wf.md inherits Phases 4 and 5 by reference; do not copy them. Document NEEDS_DECISION and FLAG lines in plugin/README.md and docs/G2G_PLUGIN_REF.md. Append a bullet to the CHANGELOG 0.8.0 section; no version bump.

tasks.title: Opt-in per-task regression check
tasks.description: Relates to F-011 (partially: only this path records the failing output; F-011 stays open). Add an optional boolean 'verifyEachTask' to .claude/g2g.json, default false. When it is exactly true, build.md Phase 3 step 8, on a REPORTED DONE, after the entry gate and after the builder's commit is confirmed to exist but before writing passes: true, runs every context.verificationCommands entry against the builder's commit, read-only, with step 7's CLEAN definition as both precondition and postcondition (the same shape as step 7 (a) and (c)). Any non-zero exit, or any drift, rescores the attempt FAILED (attempts + 1, blocked at 2 as usual) with notes naming the command, its exit code, and the last 20 lines of its output, so a regression is caught at the task that caused it. Skip the check for a fallback DONE: step 7 (b) already ran the commands. The builder's commit stays on the branch either way. In plugin/workflows/g2g-build.js accept an optional boolean arg 'verifyEachTask' (not added to the required list); when it is exactly true, a regression agent runs after a DONE report and before the complete writer, reporting per-command exit codes, output tails, and whether the tree was clean before and after; any failure turns the report into FAILED and takes the existing FAILED branch. build-wf.md Phase 1 reads verifyEachTask from .claude/g2g.json (default false) alongside models.builder, and Phase 3's args carry it. Add "verifyEachTask": false to every plugin/templates/*.json and pin it in tests/templates.bats. Document the field under Config in plugin/README.md, with its default and the cost (the full verification suite runs once per task). Append a bullet to the CHANGELOG 0.8.0 section; no version bump.
